answer: Give every agent an island atlas tundra wayfinder license, earned by proving real work. First, an agent stakes 90 POA and registers one hardware key. Second, it must complete five deliveries, each signed by a different peer and logged in an atlas. Third, the license activates only after 14 days without dispute; cheating slashes the 90 POA and revokes the key for a year. Forging 1,000 licenses would cost 90,000 POA, 5,000 staged deliveries, and 14,000 days of waiting. Like a tundra guide who trusts only travellers he has watched cross the ice, the island stays open to the honest.
